deadly-aspects.name: Deadly Aspects
deadly-aspects.r1: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 2% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 2% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
deadly-aspects.rmax: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

endurance-training.name: Endurance Training
endurance-training.r1: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 3%.
endurance-training.rmax: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

focused-fire.name: Focused Fire
focused-fire.r1: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 1% while your pet is active.
focused-fire.rmax: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

improved-aspect-of-the-monkey.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
improved-aspect-of-the-monkey.r1: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 2%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.
improved-aspect-of-the-monkey.rmax: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 6%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

improved-revive-pet.name: Improved Revive Pet
improved-revive-pet.r1: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 3 sec, mana cost is reduced by 20%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 15%.
improved-revive-pet.rmax: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

pathfinding.name: Pathfinding
pathfinding.r1: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 3%.
pathfinding.rmax: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

bestial-swiftness.name: Bestial Swiftness
bestial-swiftness.r1: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.
bestial-swiftness.rmax: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

unleashed-fury.name: Unleashed Fury
unleashed-fury.r1: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 3%.
unleashed-fury.rmax: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.

improved-mend-pet.name: Improved Mend Pet
improved-mend-pet.r1: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 15% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 10%.
improved-mend-pet.rmax: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 2%.
ferocity.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

summon-hawk.name: Summon Hawk
summon-hawk.r1: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 34 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
summon-hawk.rmax: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 34 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

spirit-bond.name: Spirit Bond
spirit-bond.r1: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 10 sec.
spirit-bond.rmax: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.cost: 8% of base mana · 100 yd range · Instant · 1 min cooldown
intimidation.r1: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
intimidation.rmax: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

bestial-discipline.name: Bestial Discipline
bestial-discipline.r1: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 10% and allows 25% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
bestial-discipline.rmax: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.r1: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.
frenzy.rmax: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

bestial-wrath.name: Bestial Wrath
bestial-wrath.cost: 12% of base mana · 100 yd range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
bestial-wrath.r1: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
bestial-wrath.rmax: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

hawk-eye.name: Hawk Eye
hawk-eye.r1: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 2 yards.
hawk-eye.rmax: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

improved-concussive-shot.name: Improved Concussive Shot
improved-concussive-shot.r1: Gives your Concussive Shot a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
improved-concussive-shot.rmax: Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

lethal-attacks.name: Lethal Attacks
lethal-attacks.r1: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.
lethal-attacks.rmax: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

improved-stings.name: Improved Stings
improved-stings.r1: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 15 sec.
improved-stings.rmax: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

efficiency.name: Efficiency
efficiency.r1: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 3%.
efficiency.rmax: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

careful-aim.name: Careful Aim
careful-aim.r1: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Intellect.
careful-aim.rmax: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

rapid-killing.name: Rapid Killing
rapid-killing.r1: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 1 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 10%.
rapid-killing.rmax: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

improved-arcane-shot.name: Improved Arcane Shot
improved-arcane-shot.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 0.3 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
improved-arcane-shot.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

lone-wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone-wolf.r1: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.
lone-wolf.rmax: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

trueshot-aura.name: Trueshot Aura
trueshot-aura.r1: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.
trueshot-aura.rmax: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

mortal-shots.name: Mortal Shots
mortal-shots.r1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 6%.
mortal-shots.rmax: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

rapid-recuperation.name: Rapid Recuperation
rapid-recuperation.r1: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 25% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 50% when Rapid Killing is consumed.
rapid-recuperation.rmax: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.r1: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 5%.
barrage.rmax: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

scatter-shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter-shot.cost: 8% of base mana · 15 yd range · 30 sec cooldown
scatter-shot.r1: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
scatter-shot.rmax: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

ranged-weapon-specialization.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
ranged-weapon-specialization.r1: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 1%.
ranged-weapon-specialization.rmax: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

sniper-shot.name: Sniper Shot
sniper-shot.cost: 365 Mana · 45 yd range · 4 sec cast · 15 sec cooldown
sniper-shot.r1: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
sniper-shot.rmax: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

improved-tracking.name: Improved Tracking
improved-tracking.r1: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.
improved-tracking.rmax: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

entrapment.name: Entrapment
entrapment.r1: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.
entrapment.rmax: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

savage-strikes.name: Savage Strikes
savage-strikes.r1: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.
savage-strikes.rmax: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 4%.

improved-wing-clip.name: Improved Wing Clip
improved-wing-clip.r1: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
improved-wing-clip.rmax: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

clever-traps.name: Clever Traps
clever-traps.r1: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.
clever-traps.rmax: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

surefooted.name: Surefooted
surefooted.r1: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.
surefooted.rmax: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

deterrence.name: Deterrence
deterrence.r1: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.
deterrence.rmax: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

survival-tactics.name: Survival Tactics
survival-tactics.r1: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.
survival-tactics.rmax: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 10%.

predator-s-edge.name: Predator's Edge
predator-s-edge.r1: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 6% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 10%.
predator-s-edge.rmax: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

counterattack.name: Counterattack
counterattack.cost: 30 Mana · Melee range · Instant · 5 sec cooldown
counterattack.r1: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
counterattack.rmax: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

resourcefulness.name: Resourcefulness
resourcefulness.r1: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 30%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 50% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.
resourcefulness.rmax: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 60%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

expose-prey.name: Expose Prey
expose-prey.r1: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 5% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.
expose-prey.rmax: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.

survivalist-s-discipline.name: Survivalist's Discipline
survivalist-s-discipline.r1: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.
survivalist-s-discipline.rmax: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

strider-kick.name: Strider Kick
strider-kick.cost: 5.81% of base mana · Melee range · Instant · 8 sec cooldown
strider-kick.r1: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
strider-kick.rmax: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

lacerating-strikes.name: Lacerating Strikes
lacerating-strikes.r1: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec
lacerating-strikes.rmax: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec
